changes.title: Skin tones
items: The dressing table's skin colours are now a full range of human skin tones (the Monk Skin Tone Scale), palest to deepest, plus five witchy tones: frost blue, lilac, ash grey, moss green and night indigo
Random witches and Randomise now pick from the full range of human skin tones
A new witch's starting skin is now the nearest tone on the new range
The skin colour you choose now stays the same after reloading the game

changes.title: Pattern spin
items: The coloured spokes of light round the playing soundsystems now visibly turn, once every 2 bars and faster as the tempo rises, on up to three nearby stumps instead of only the nearest

changes.title: Berry spread
items: Twice as many berry patches in every area
Berry patches are spread evenly through each area's woods instead of bunching together
Berry bushes and mushrooms no longer grow in a stump's fighting ground: they keep about 55 m from every stump
Mushrooms no longer grow beside berry bushes or on paths, unless there's nowhere else in the area

changes.title: Dive order
items: Sailing hands over to the dive sooner, especially to big islands: the grass is grown during the dive instead of before it.

During the dive the island loads in a better order: the house, the coast's sand and waves, the trees you can see most of, the stumps and campfires, then the animals; the beach's shells and starfish come last.
Each area's mist now waits until its trees, stumps, campfires and animals are actually drawn, then fades away over a few seconds instead of vanishing.
The dive flies higher over the island, in a darker, hazier light that eases back to the night's as you land.
